name: transferrin receptor
pathways: positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: TFRC encodes transferrin receptor protein 1 [Cleaved into: Transferrin receptor protein 1, serum form]. Annotated molecular activities include protein homodimerization activity and transferrin receptor activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to TFRC-related combined immunodeficiency (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
